items.quote: These are those that were numbered, which Moses and Aaron numbered, and the princes of Israel, being twelve men: each one was for the house of his fathers.
items.claim: Moses and Aaron, together with twelve princes of Israel, carried out a census, and each prince stood for his own ancestral house. Passes 1 and 2 agree on this item; pass 3 was empty. Identifying the verse as Numbers 1:44 is a model-prior guess, not something the document says.
items.actor: Moses and Aaron, with the twelve princes of Israel
items.object: the people of Israel, by ancestral house
items.mechanism: one prince per ancestral house (house of his fathers) as representative
